waypoints.name: Old Manhatto
waypoints.notes: Ishmael begins from the island city he calls Manhatto.

waypoints.name: New Bedford
waypoints.notes: Ishmael arrives after quitting Manhatto and waits for the Nantucket packet.

waypoints.name: Nantucket
waypoints.notes: Pequod home port and the point from which the whaling voyage begins.

waypoints.name: North Atlantic off Nantucket
waypoints.notes: An offshore modeling anchor for the first days after the Pequod leaves Nantucket.

waypoints.name: South Atlantic trades
waypoints.notes: A schematic open-ocean anchor for Ahab's southward Atlantic passage.

waypoints.name: Cape of Good Hope waters
waypoints.notes: The Spirit-Spout chapter names the Cape winds and Cape of Good Hope seas.

waypoints.name: Waters off the Crozet Islands
waypoints.notes: Chapter 52 places the Albatross southeastward from the Cape, off the distant Crozetts.

waypoints.name: Indian Ocean Line
waypoints.notes: Chapter 60 refers to this part of the Indian Ocean and the Line.

waypoints.name: Eastern Indian Ocean whale-ground
waypoints.notes: A modeled cruising-ground anchor before the Pequod closes on Java Head.

waypoints.name: Java Head
waypoints.notes: Chapter 87 names Java Head at the Straits of Sunda.

waypoints.name: Javan Sea
waypoints.notes: Ahab intends to pass through Sunda into the Javan Sea.

waypoints.name: Formosa and Bashee approach
waypoints.notes: Chapter 109 says the Pequod draws nigh to Formosa and the Bashee Isles.

waypoints.name: Bashee Isles
waypoints.notes: Chapter 111 begins as the Pequod glides by the Bashee Isles into the Pacific.

waypoints.name: Japanese cruising-ground
waypoints.notes: The text repeatedly names the Japanese cruising-ground and Japanese seas.

waypoints.name: Eastern Japanese whale-ground
waypoints.notes: A local open-ocean anchor for the Japanese-ground whale chases and gams.

waypoints.name: Pacific Line approach
waypoints.notes: Ahab turns from the Japanese seas toward the equatorial whaling ground.

waypoints.name: Equatorial Pacific fishing-ground
waypoints.notes: Chapter 126 says the Pequod nears the outskirts of the Equatorial fishing-ground.

waypoints.name: Rachel encounter waters
waypoints.notes: A modeled point for the Rachel gam after her boat sees Moby Dick the previous day.

waypoints.name: Delight encounter waters
waypoints.notes: A local modeling anchor for the final warning gam before the chase.

waypoints.name: First day chase waters
waypoints.notes: A short-range chase anchor for the first day with Moby Dick.

waypoints.name: Second day chase waters
waypoints.notes: A short-range chase anchor for the second day.

waypoints.name: Pequod wreck
waypoints.notes: Estimated final wreck coordinate on the Pacific Line; the book gives no exact latitude or longitude.

waypoints.name: Rachel rescue
waypoints.notes: Ishmael drifts for almost one day and night before the Rachel finds him.

paths.title: Manhatto to New Bedford
paths.notes: Ishmael says he quits old Manhatto and duly arrives in New Bedford; the exact conveyance is not specified, so the curve follows a plausible coastal approach.

paths.title: The Moss packet to Nantucket
paths.notes: Ishmael and Queequeg board the little packet schooner Moss and make a fine run to Nantucket.

paths.title: Pequod clears Nantucket
paths.notes: The Pequod is boarded at Nantucket and leaves on Christmas; the offshore endpoint represents the first open Atlantic stage.

paths.title: Outward North Atlantic cruise
paths.notes: The shipboard chapters carry the Pequod away from Nantucket before Ahab charts the broader hunt; this segment is a schematic Atlantic southbound run.

sourceRefs.label: Ahab appears after several days at sea
Ahab reveals the White Whale hunt

paths.title: South Atlantic to Cape of Good Hope
paths.notes: Ahab studies the whale grounds and the Spirit-Spout leads the Pequod toward the Cape winds and Cape of Good Hope seas.

sourceRefs.label: Cape winds and Cape of Good Hope

paths.title: Cape to the distant Crozetts
paths.notes: Chapter 52 places the Albatross southeastward from the Cape, off the Crozet region.

paths.title: Crozet waters to the Indian Ocean Line
paths.notes: The intervening gams and whaling chapters are modeled as an east-northeast Indian Ocean cruise toward the Line.

sourceRefs.label: this part of the Indian Ocean

paths.title: Indian Ocean whaling cruise
paths.notes: Stubb kills a whale and the narrative remains on whaling work and shipboard anatomy while the Pequod ranges eastward.

sourceRefs.label: wide intervals of latitude and longitude

paths.title: Eastern Indian Ocean to Java Head
paths.notes: The route bends toward Java before the Grand Armada chapter explicitly places the ship near the Sunda gateway.

sourceRefs.label: drawing nigh to the Straits of Sunda

paths.title: Sunda Strait and Javan Sea
paths.notes: Ahab intends to pass through Sunda into the Javan Sea, where the Grand Armada appears near Java Head.

sourceRefs.label: Java Head and the Javan Sea

paths.title: Javan Sea to Formosa and the Bashees
paths.notes: After Sunda, the Pequod sweeps north by island waters until chapter 109 places her near Formosa and the Bashee Isles.

sourceRefs.label: drawing nigh to Formosa and Bashee Isles

paths.title: Bashee Isles to the Japanese cruising-ground
paths.notes: The Pequod enters the Pacific by the Bashees and glides toward the Japanese cruising-ground.

paths.title: Whaling on the Japanese ground
paths.notes: The Pequod penetrates the Japanese cruising-ground, lowers boats, meets the Bachelor, and kills whales.

sourceRefs.label: heart of the Japanese cruising ground

paths.title: Japanese seas toward the Pacific Line
paths.notes: When the season for the Line draws near, Ahab points the ship toward the Equator and the outskirts of the Equatorial fishing-ground.

paths.title: Equatorial search and final gams
paths.notes: The Rachel has seen Moby Dick near this ground, and the Pequod refuses to join her search before meeting the battered Delight.

paths.title: The chase - first day
paths.notes: The first day of the local chase is represented by a short open-ocean displacement on the Line.

paths.title: The chase - second day
paths.notes: A second short chase leg captures the repeated lowering, loss, and night pursuit without claiming exact coordinates.

paths.title: The chase - third day and Pequod wreck
paths.notes: The final leg ends at the wreck of the Pequod after Moby Dick rams the ship.

paths.title: Ishmael drift and Rachel rescue
paths.notes: Ishmael floats on Queequeg's coffin life-buoy for almost one whole day and night before the Rachel picks him up.
